verdict.rationale: Live-session egress to RTMP or HLS is a fair question for a real-time communications SDK, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers meetings, audio and video codecs, data messages, screen sharing and PSTN, but nothing documents streaming a session out to RTMP or HLS for a large audience. With no evidence for an applicable capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, a live session can be egressed to RTMP or HLS so a large audience watches without joining the session
